mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a weakening labor market, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within the last month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between RSAFS increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure combined with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in a month and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline simultaneously, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to decline.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3% and PAYEMS declines in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 5% in a month and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) also decline, it signals a weakening demand side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to decline.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 5% and RSAFS declines in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
